posts.title: Writing web services in the AI-era
posts.description: AI is making rewrites cheap and vulnerabilities easier to find. The stack that survives will be layered, boring at the boundaries, and easy for agents to swap one piece at a time.

posts.title: What happened in December 2025 or how I got a 40x speedup?
posts.description: I'm quite late to the discussion, but everyone has been saying that they have not written code since December. What happened? The release of Gemini 3 Pro, GPT-5.1 and Claude Opus 4.5 was a game changer. It was the first time that models were 'smart enough' to accomplish complex tasks.

posts.title: Vercel-like development setup for Django using Caddy
posts.description: Get {branch}.dev.yourdomain.com previews for Django (or any WSGI app) with a single VM, Caddy, and rsync—no Kubernetes required.
